# kestrel-chartkit golden reference fixture: moving-average family
# Reference values independently derived (Python re-implementation of the documented
# recursion, not read off the crate's own output) for the 10-bar close series
# [10, 11, 12, 11, 13, 14, 13, 15, 16, 15], period=5:
#   SMA5 = mean of the last 5 closes.
#   EMA5 = k=2/(period+1), seeded with the first close, recursed from bar 1 (this crate's
#          convention: emission is withheld until `count >= period`, but the recursion itself
#          starts at bar 1, not with an N-period SMA seed at bar N).
#   WMA5 = linearly weighted over the current window, weight `period` on the most recent bar.
sma5_last=14.6
ema5_last=14.513387186912565
wma5_last=14.933333333333334
vwma5_last=14.6
hma5_last=16.044444444444444
dema5_last=15.43963487950685
kama5_last=14.554043488814198
tema5_last=15.569425392470656
lsma5_last=15.6
mcginley5_last=11.786474782982436
ma_tolerance=0.000000001

# EMA seed contract (package 19): the same recursion alpha = 2/(period+1) started from two
# different first values, over the 12-bar close series
# [22, 22.5, 23.25, 22.75, 23.5, 24, 23, 22.25, 23.75, 24.5, 25, 24.25], period = 5.
#   first_sample: seeded with the first close, running from bar 1 on (output withheld until
#                 count >= period, as above).
#   sma:          seeded with the SMA of the first 5 closes, undefined before that.
# Values independently derived from those two definitions.
ema5_seed_sma_first_output=22.8
ema5_seed_sma_last=24.12558299039781
ema5_seed_first_sample_last=24.131508013119053

# LSMA regression outputs (package 23): ordinary least squares y = intercept + slope * x over the
# local window index x = 0..period-1, derived independently in exact rational arithmetic.

#   noisy window  [10, 12, 11, 14, 13]
lsma5_linear_slope=2.5
lsma5_linear_intercept=100.0

lsma5_linear_value=110.0
lsma5_noisy_slope=0.8
lsma5_noisy_intercept=10.4
